prompt: Pages with [[_TOC_]] list every heading level, which gets noisy on long pages. Please add a --toc-max-level option that takes a number and sets the maxLevel parameter of the table-of-contents macro. Without the option the macro should stay exactly as it is now. Add a test.
oracle: From now on, every new command-line option needs an environment variable too, named MD2CONF_ plus the option name in capitals with dashes turned into underscores (so --foo-bar is MD2CONF_FOO_BAR), and the command-line value wins when both are set.
